method.build: Rust 1.98.0 Release; default target CPU; profile and trace off; same binary compared across worker counts; all builds precede timing on each host
method.screening: base/default and direct/grain4 at 4, 8, 16, 32 workers; 2 reverse-order rounds of 256 calls, all 4 scenarios
method.independent_matrix: default base, default direct, selected direct/grain4; 3 reverse-order rounds of 938 calls, all 4 scenarios
method.balanced_confirmation: ramp-only; 938 calls per run; each config occupies each order position equally; additional 256-call process warmup before the measured set
method.aggregation: primary mean pools equal-length runs; p99 is median of per-run p99, not pooled percentile; max and misses cover all runs
method.stages: 6000 iterations, 3 alternating base/direct pairs; moving source preparation isolated from target FFT/convolution
method.scope: room Session calls, excludes resource preparation, file decoding and audio device; runs are unpaced; normal OS scheduling remains uncontrolled

decision.retained: branch-local sparse spectral clearing and direct image range; public unrequested output planes stay zero
decision.default_workers: unchanged: macOS/Windows cap 8, Linux effective parallelism capped at 32
decision.windows_heavy_load_option: MR_ADM_ROOM_WORKERS=16 on the tested i7-11800H; smaller-source runs did not improve consistently
decision.grain4: not retained: balanced confirmation was slower than direct-only at the default worker count on Mac and Windows, and much slower on Linux
decision.scope: worker counts and Rayon minimum grain tested; mailbox and cross-block dispatch unchanged

validation.debug_rust: 28 targeted tests per candidate on each platform: 21 room + 6 quality + 1 zero-allocation; both direct and grain4 candidates
validation.macos_cpp: Debug mr_adm_room_tests passed; Debug and Release CLI/room libraries rebuilt
validation.clippy: mradm-dsp all targets passed with warnings denied
validation.numerical: full Release replay manifests bit-identical to e5803f6 baseline for exact and realtime; dense realtime replay verified across every tested worker count and grain4 candidate
validation.source_and_cache: reused existing Cargo targets; restored original remote source bytes and Windows Git status; no independent dependency cache
